about_paragraphs: I'm a dedicated AI and software engineering student with a strong passion for problem-solving and building impactful digital systems. My journey into technology began during high school and evolved into a deep interest in artificial intelligence, data science, and full-stack development.

Through internships, research, and personal projects, I have explored large language models, machine learning pipelines, distributed training, and scalable backend architectures. I actively participate in coding competitions and hackathons to sharpen my problem-solving skills.

Beyond coding, I maintain creativity and focus through badminton, travel, and exploring cutting-edge AI research. I enjoy transforming ideas from research papers into practical applications and building systems that push technological boundaries.

projects.title: AI-Powered YouTube Filtering Extension
projects.description: A Chrome extension that filters and recommends YouTube videos based on user-defined prompts and session times.
projects.detailed_description: This Chrome extension leverages NLP and machine learning to semantically analyze video metadata including titles, descriptions, captions, and comments. Users can define prompts and time-based sessions to filter or highlight videos while ensuring the recommendation system remains neutral. Real-time API handling, dynamic DOM injection, and session tracking enable seamless user experience.
projects.challenges: Ensuring real-time DOM updates and filtering without disrupting YouTube's native recommendation system
projects.outcome: Improved user control over video consumption and enhanced personalized experience

projects.title: Website Emotion and Vulnerability Analyzer
projects.description: An NLP-powered tool that analyzes websites to detect emotional tone, semantic context, and potential security risks.
projects.detailed_description: This tool processes website URLs to evaluate content for emotional tone, semantic meaning, and potential vulnerabilities. It acts as a pre-access evaluator to help users assess website trustworthiness. Using NLP pipelines and heuristic-based engines, the system predicts emotions, detects risks, and provides actionable insights.
projects.challenges: Designing accurate heuristics and NLP pipelines to analyze diverse web content reliably
projects.outcome: Enabled safer browsing and informed decision-making for users

projects.title: Corpus-Based Enterprise Chatbot Generator
projects.description: A low-code platform that generates domain-specific chatbots for small businesses using AI and NLP.
projects.detailed_description: This platform simplifies chatbot creation for small businesses by ingesting PDFs and building knowledge bases. It leverages LangChain, FAISS vector stores, and OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo for generating responsive chatbots capable of handling customer support and internal queries. Users can create chatbots without coding knowledge.
projects.challenges: Ensuring accurate response generation and managing knowledge base embeddings efficiently
projects.outcome: Reduced setup complexity for non-technical users and improved internal support workflows

projects.title: Review Classification and AI Summarizer for E-Commerce
projects.description: Processes user reviews for sentiment, spam detection, and summary using Gemini Pro API.
projects.detailed_description: This project processes user reviews using NLP pipelines to detect spam, classify emotion and polarity, and generate concise summaries. The integration of Gemini Pro API allows for accurate summarization of product feedback. The system enhances review browsing efficiency and provides analytics for product improvement and sentiment tracking.
projects.challenges: Processing large volumes of reviews and generating accurate, concise summaries
projects.outcome: Enhanced review readability and provided actionable insights for businesses

projects.title: Home Fitness Tracker and Recommendation Web App
projects.description: Personalized web app to track workouts, monitor progress, and get fitness recommendations.
projects.detailed_description: This full-stack platform allows users to log workouts, set goals, and monitor daily activity. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, it integrates third-party APIs for exercise datasets and instructional videos. Users receive personalized fitness plans based on performance analytics.
projects.challenges: Designing adaptive recommendation algorithms and integrating multiple APIs
projects.outcome: Enabled users to achieve fitness goals with personalized guidance

projects.title: Entrepreneurial Recommendation Platform
projects.description: ML-powered platform to match entrepreneurs based on profiles, skills, and goals.
projects.detailed_description: This platform uses embedding generation, similarity scoring, and NLP semantic analysis to recommend collaborations between entrepreneurs. The system includes a full-stack React + Node.js interface with Flask APIs for ML inference.
projects.challenges: Balancing accuracy of recommendations with scalability and real-time performance
projects.outcome: Improved networking efficiency and meaningful business collaborations

projects.title: Recruitment Analytics Platform
projects.description: Data-driven recruitment system automating candidate evaluation using AI and vector search.
projects.detailed_description: This system parses candidate resumes, generates embeddings, and uses Qdrant-based vector similarity search to score candidates against job requirements. Built with Python, Flask, and MongoDB, the platform exposes REST APIs for automated candidate evaluation and shortlisting. It enhances fairness, scalability, and efficiency in recruitment processes.
projects.challenges: Ensuring accurate matching and efficient vector search across large candidate datasets
projects.outcome: Streamlined recruitment process and improved shortlisting efficiency
